points: Iran's Supreme National Security Council denied planning military retaliation over recent restrictions on Iranian flights, stating negotiations are underway to lift restrictions and any reciprocal measures would be non-military and target only certain airports. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/7548)
Air defense systems in Hormozgan Province, southern Iran, declared a red alert status, indicating heightened readiness against potential aerial threats. (Source: @shin_persian/10457)

Senior Iranian armed forces spokesperson Brigadier General Shakarji declared Trump and Netanyahu as murderers who will be punished, vowing Iran will not forget the killers of Imam Khomeini and the oppressed Iranian people even after the war ends. (Source: @SharghDaily/185998)

Iran proposed a seven-day plan: Hormuz Strait reopening and nuclear talks resumption within a week if the US lifts its naval blockade of Iranian ports, removes oil sanctions, and restores a regional ceasefire; Trump rejected the proposal according to US officials. (Source: @VahidOnline/78539, @mamlekate/104632, @asafroz/53807)
Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi is staying longer in New York to continue indirect negotiations with US negotiators over Hormuz control and nuclear issues. (Source: @shin_persian/10461)

Pro-Iranian channels claimed missiles hit four ships violating Iranian naval orders, with a destroyer reportedly sunk, though independent verification is lacking. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/395161, @rasedal3ado138e/395167)

Iranian armed forces spokesperson emphasized asymmetric warfare tactics based on sacrifice, belief, and spirituality led to victory against expensive enemy heavy weapons. (Source: @SharghDaily/185996)

IDF conducted two strikes in Gaza on Friday: in Nuseirat, eliminated Hamas Nukhba platoon commander Ibrahim Fuzi Ismail Mahsen; in Khan Younis, eliminated Muhammad Kamel Suleiman Muhsen, both accused of planning terror attacks and rebuilding Hamas capabilities in violation of the ceasefire. (Source: @idf_telegram/25227)

Hamas political bureau chief Khalil al-Hayya stated he met American officials multiple times, presented Palestinian demands, and felt understanding from them, while accusing Israel of seeking to expel the Palestinian people. (Source: @yediotnews25/135365)
Iranian armed forces spokesperson labeled Trump and Netanyahu as murderers who will face punishment for their crimes against Iran. (Source: @SharghDaily/185998)

White House stated Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping agreed Iran must never obtain nuclear weapons and no country should impose tolls on international waterways, referencing Hormuz Strait. (Source: @mamlekate/104635)
Israeli political commentary from Amit Segal criticized Netanyahu's leadership and referenced upcoming elections, but no operational military details were provided. (Source: @amitsegal/65193)

IDF strikes in Nuseirat and Khan Younis targeted Hamas military operatives: Nukhba platoon commander Ibrahim Fuzi Ismail Mahsen and Muhammad Kamel Suleiman Muhsen, both accused of advancing terror plans against IDF forces and Israeli civilians while systematically violating the ceasefire agreement. (Source: @idf_telegram/25227)

Hamas leader Khalil al-Hayya claimed repeated meetings with US officials where Palestinian demands were presented and understanding was sensed, while warning against Israeli transfer plans for the Palestinian population. (Source: @yediotnews25/135365)
IDF Southern Command forces remain deployed in Gaza per the ceasefire agreement and will continue acting to remove immediate threats. (Source: @idf_telegram/25227)

Hezbollah-affiliated channel posted statement: "Israel this cancerous gland will fall and vanish sooner or later," attributed to Sayyed Hashem Safi al-Din. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/395182)
Thousands of Iraqis gathered in Baghdad's Tahrir Square to commemorate the martyrdom anniversary of Hezbollah leaders Sayyed Hassan Nasrallah and Sayyed Hashem Safi al-Din. (Source: @presstv/208453)

sections.threat_assessment: The simultaneous kinetic action in Gaza, heightened alert status in Hormozgan, and intense Lebanese border activity indicate a multi-front escalation risk. Iran's asymmetric warfare doctrine and denial of military retaliation over flight restrictions suggest calibrated pressure, while Trump's rejection of the Hormuz-linked proposal removes a near-term de-escalation pathway. The 60 million barrels transiting Hormuz in 72 hours underscores the global energy stakes of any miscalculation.
sections.regional_response: Oman's explicit endorsement of the 1967 borders two-state solution and condemnation of Israeli attacks aligns with Gulf consensus but adds emphasis on Hormuz security. Qatar's mediation efforts reflect continued Gulf diplomatic engagement despite wide gaps. Iraq's public commemoration of Hezbollah leaders signals enduring Iranian influence in Baghdad. The White House joint statement with China on Iranian nuclear prohibition and freedom of navigation signals great-power convergence on red lines.
sections.intelligence_notes: The discrepancy between Iranian claims of striking four ships and the Supreme National Security Council's denial of military retaliation warrants scrutiny for internal signaling versus operational reality. The 120-second delayed reporting of Hormozgan red alert suggests operational security protocols. The September 2026 date in Lebanese monitoring data may indicate a scheduling error or future-dated template. Araghchi's extended New York stay implies negotiations remain active despite public rejection of the seven-day framework.
